Messages.Author: magus
Messages.Body:
Hi people, i choose to play a BB deck.

And i hav ea problem with a card :

Free Fight
Card Text:
Only usable before range is determined.
[san] Tap this Blood Brother and any number of ready untapped members
you control of this circle. Once each round before range is determined,
or whenever your combatant leaves the ready region, you may choose one
of these ready Blood Brothers to become the combatant instead (and
combat continues).
[SAN] As above, and each of these Blood Brothers gets an optional press
this combat.

i read a lot fo topic, but normaly you have to TAP the Blood Brother
who plays the card. But if he blocks he is tapped. Can he plays the
card?

This problem create an other for me:
Can a vampire Tap a vampire which is allready tapped ( by playing a
card like "Jar the Soul" ? ( i think no , but i prefer ask ) )

Thank a lot

Messages.Author: tzimisce_dragon
Messages.Body:
it's a combat card and it says "tap this blood brother and....". It
does not say "tap.... TO".

So, even if you are tapped, you can still play the card, as it is a
combat card and it doesn't
require you to tap to use the effect, but just to tap if you are
untapped.

Messages.Author: tzimisce_dragon
Messages.Body:
...of course, the "extra" blood brothers that you want to use and tap
must be ready and untapped, by card text...

Messages.Author: tzimisce_dragon
Messages.Body:
special report says: "this vampire untaps and ATTEMPTS to block..."
so, if the action is a 0 stealth one, then you are forced to attempt to
block. if it is a +1 or more stealth action, then if you don't wish to
burn
a pool to give the vampire +1 intercept, then the vampire just untaps,
attempts to block and fails to block, remaining untapped.

You cannot play special report to untap a vampire, when your vampire
cannot
even try to block. For example, if you control Ira Rivers and he is
tapped, you
cannot play Special Report to untap him, while your prey performs a
bleed action.

As, Ira is not an eligible blocker for this kind of action. If Ira is
untapped, you can play
eagle's sight and then you have the option to Use Special Report if you
need the
intercept.
